#.label: Checkout App Settings
#/properties/mpos/properties/server/prop: The timeout for network calls. In milliseconds.
#/properties/mpos/properties/autoUpdate/: The channel for the update. Customers must use only the preview and stable channels - internal is reserved. All new updates will appear in the preview channel before being promoted to the stable channel. A preview channel will get preview and stable updates. A stable channel will get only stable updates. Customers are encouraged to setup a few tills on the preview channels to test drive new updates before being promoted to stable.
#/properties/mpos/properties/wallpaperUr: URI for the wallpaper image. Accepts an https image URL (.jpg/.jpeg/.png) or a base64 data URI.
#/properties/mpos/properties/customerOrd: Customer order settings. Choose "None" to disable, or configure search/cancel/create behavior.
#/properties/mpos/properties/connect/pro: Sets the soft (mobile) payment terminal provider.
#/properties/mpos/properties/lock/proper: The number of seconds the register is idle before it is auto-locked.
#/properties/mpos/properties/logs/proper: Indicates if the logs should be uploaded to the server. This also enables the logs button in the settings drawer.
#/properties/mpos/properties/transaction: The authorization provider used for transaction lookups. Default: iam.
Regular expression used to detect internal transaction numbers (RegularOrder).
When enabled, transaction numbers matching the external pattern will be treated as external.
Regular expression for external transaction numbers. Write it as a JSON string with escaped backslashes (e.g. \d{6}), without leading/trailing slashes.
Controls which actions are available on the transaction search details view (refund, complaint, print copy, print gift receipt). Choose "None" to use the defaults.
#/properties/mpos/properties/inAppLinksE: Set true to allow in-app link handling.
#/properties/mpos/properties/trainingMod: Controls the availability of training mode.
#/properties/mpos/properties/receipt/pro: The duration for which the receipt remains visible after finalization. In milliseconds.
When true, the app displays the rounded amount due.
Defines whether voided items should be rendered on the Active Receipt.

Toggles visibility of the listed item attributes in the receipt.

Used to set the lock keybinding. Triggers the opening of the lock confirmation dialog.

Used to set the secondary payment method keybinding.
Primary Payment Method
Used to set the primary payment method keybinding. In the POS application, the primary payment method is assigned to the highlighted button in the payment menu.
Open PLU
Used to set the open PLU keybinding.
Open Transaction Search
Used to set the open transactions search keybinding.
Open Embedded Web Browser
Used to set the open embedded web browser keybinding. Requires the corresponding feature flag to be enabled.
Open Variant Search
Used to set the open variant search keybinding. Requires the corresponding feature flag to be enabled.

Used to set the open rescan keybinding. Requires the corresponding feature flag to be enabled.

Used to set the open B2B customer search keybinding.

App colors, typography, and component ro: App colors, typography, and component roundness are managed as the tenant theme configuration object and applied across POS, SCO, and CFD.
Per-day opening hours (MO/TU/…/WORKDAYS/: Per-day opening hours (MO/TU/…/WORKDAYS/WEEKEND) are pattern-keyed in the data schema and cannot be rendered by JSON Forms — set them via the API. A renderable shape is proposed in HRP-727.
